{{Conjecture|legends}}
An '''acting troupe''' was set up in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], by [[Ackmena/Legends|Ackmena]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]], and [[Cebann Veekan]], an [[Hamadryas]] [[Actor/Legends|actor]], at some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The two arranged performances at [[Chalmun/Legends|Chalmun's]] [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Spaceport Cantina]].
